## Why visit

A useful newer addition for beer hunters who already know Manchester’s established brewery names. The modest taproom places changing cask from Steelfish and nearby brewers alongside a small keg range, keeping the visit focused and manageable. It is worth considering as an extra to the Piccadilly brewery cluster, particularly if the day’s cask selection looks distinctive. The published real-cider flag and simple food add interest, while the relatively recent opening makes direct confirmation of hours especially sensible before building a route around it.
